title: Perimeter and Missing Side Lengths
introduction: Build Primary 4 mathematical understanding through perimeter and missing side lengths.
definition: Perimeter measures the outside boundary of a shape. For rectilinear polygons, horizontal distances in opposite directions balance, as do vertical distances. Find missing sides before adding the outer boundary.

visuals.label: L-shaped perimeter
visuals.description: The missing corner does not change the perimeter of this outer rectangle.
visuals.alt: L-shaped perimeter — The missing corner does not change the perimeter of this outer rectangle.

examples.question: A rectangle has perimeter 34 cm and width 6 cm. Find its length.
An L-shape has outer width 9 cm and outer height 7 cm, with one rectangular corner removed.
steps: Horizontal lengths total 18; vertical lengths total 14.
